Before: two fried eggs, an English muffin (two halves), two slices of raisin toast, orange juice (~200 ml), two apricot jams, two butters. After: everything is eaten except a small amount of juice left in the glass.

- Eggs (2 fried): ~100 g, ~180 kcal
- English muffin: ~60 g, ~140 kcal
- Raisin toast (2 slices): ~70 g, ~200 kcal
- Orange juice: ~180 g, ~80 kcal
- Jam (2 portions): ~28 g, ~70 kcal
- Butter (2 portions): ~20 g, ~145 kcal

Total: about 458 g and 815 kcal.
